about: 회계 II › 계약관리 — 품목연결설정 · 회계/판매일괄반영 [판매반영](E060906, 2026-10-13 원본 실측 — 계약항목 00007 렌탈 품목관리 D001 1 × 120,000 · D002 1 × 220,000, QA회계2-렌탈 계약 · 청구 -7). 계약항목 [품목별단가 › 설정] 이 주황이고 창에 두 줄 · 합계. 판매반영 격자에 상세-품목연결설정을 붙인 청구만 나온다. 안 고르고 [판매전표 발행] → '알림' '리스트에 선택된 자료가 없습니다.'. 고르고 누르면 판매입력(줄 = 연결 품목) → [저장(F8)] → 판매 한 장, 그 거래처 줄은 격자에서 빠진다. 만든 판매 · 청구 · 계약 · 항목 · 거래처는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 거래처 · 품목연결 계약항목 · 계약(상세 적용) · 청구자료(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const wh=(await window.__api('GET','/warehouses')).body;const w=wh.find((x)=>x.code==='100')??wh.find((x)=>x.name==='본사창고')??wh[0];sessionStorage.setItem('whId',w.id);sessionStorage.setItem('whCode',w.code);const st=(await window.__api('GET','/stock')).body.filter((x)=>x.warehouseId===w.id&&x.quantity>=5).slice(0,2);const c='S'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);sessionStorage.setItem('ciCode',c);const p=(await window.__api('POST','/partners',{code:'QS'+String(Date.now()).slice(-5),name:'QA회계2-판매반영거래처',type:'CUSTOMER'})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('pId',p.id);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-렌탈항목',unitPrice:3000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'ONCE',salesAccountId:null,products:[{itemId:st[0].itemId,quantity:1,unitPrice:1000},{itemId:st[1].itemId,quantity:1,unitPrice:2000}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const bc=(await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-렌탈계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:ymd.slice(5,7),quantity:1,unitPrice:3000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:'QA회계2',products:it.products}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',bc.id);const b=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills',{billDate:ymd,vatType:'세금계산서',byPartner:false,lines:[{contractLineId:bc.lines[0].id,billMonth:ymd.slice(0,7),quantity:1,unitPrice:3000,supplyAmount:3000,vatAmount:300,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body[0];sessionStorage.setItem('bId',b.id);return it.productPrice+' '+bc.lines[0].products.length})()

steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const bills=(await window.__api('GET','/contract-bills')).body;const b=bills.find((x)=>x.id===Number(sessionStorage.getItem('bId')));const ls=(await window.__api('GET','/contract-bills/lines')).body.filter((l)=>l.billId===b.id);const s=ls[0].salesId;const r1=s?await window.__api('DELETE','/sales/'+s):{status:'-'};const a=await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills/delete',{ids:[b.id]});const c=await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts/delete',{ids:[Number(sessionStorage.getItem('bcId'))]});const e=await window.__api('DELETE','/contract-items/'+sessionStorage.getItem('ciId'));const f=await window.__api('DELETE','/partners/'+sessionStorage.getItem('pId'));return s+' '+r1.status+' '+a.status+' '+c.status+' '+e.status+' '+f.status})()
